sentences.text: A VHF radio with digital selective calling has a red distress button.
Pressing it sends an automatic alert with your MMSI number and GPS position on channel seventy, which the Coast Guard and nearby DSC radios receive.
Then follow up by voice on channel sixteen.
An EPIRB sends a distress signal on four hundred six megahertz to satellites, which relay your identity and position to rescuers.
It must be registered with NOAA.
A personal locator beacon does the same for an individual.
Keep beacon registrations, batteries and hydrostatic releases current.
